wheel_metadata.description: Analysis-ready wheel position. Pipeline: unwrap 12-bit encoder (jump_thresh=2000, wrap_val=4096) at 30000 Hz → decimate to 1000 Hz (scipy.signal.decimate, IIR, zero-phase) → 20 Hz low-pass (2nd-order Butterworth, zero-phase). This is the signal used in the movement-onset analysis (manuscript wheel figure).
